jobs.title: Director Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking an experienced Director Product Manager to join Adobe Commerce product management team in San Jose. In this role, you will be leading a team of product managers, defining the long-term vision and strategy for Commerce Storefront, and drive capabilities to enable Agentic conversion across all emerging channels. Strong leadership skills will be required to drive consensus on requirements, deliver high quality outcomes, and maintain a fast pace of execution.

Success will be measured by near-term enterprise customer success, existing install base retention, and the ability to drive a differentiated vision into product reality for the long-term in a manner that drives near-term market momentum.

What You'll Do

Lead a team of product managers to define and champion product vision and strategy for Agentic conversion on e-commerce channels including storefront, LLM interfaces, marketplaces, social channels and more.
Work collaboratively with the rest of the Digital Experience and Digital Media product teams to ensure we bring innovation from the rest of Adobe, to Adobe Commerce.
Execute on the product strategy, roadmap, and requirements by working closely with customers, partners, internal product teams, engineering, and senior management.
Research customer and market needs, conduct competitive analysis
Define prioritized feature requirements along with an overall product roadmap. Measure and assess the efficacy of the product roadmap for customer delight and business success
Introduce capabilities in the product and partner with GTM teams to take an early-stage product and drive adoption at global scale.
Support deals and deliver product presentations and demonstrations that highlight product value
Mentor, manage, and develop your team.

What you need to succeed:

BS in Engineering or equivalent experience. MBA is preferred.
Proven track record of defining product requirements and delivering successful products. Overall 10+ years of experience in product management with a minimum of 3 years of experience in managing a team of product managers is highly desirable.
Deep technical expertise in front-end technologies, e-commerce storefront, e-commerce stack, content personalization, and large complex, cloud-based systems for enterprise and mid-sized organizations.
Ability to connect business and user design requirements to concrete product requirements
Experience in agile software development practices within a large team environment desirable.
Strong verbal and written communication skills; strong presentation skills; ability to work across teams with geographically remote team members.
Demonstrated proficiencies in making data-driven recommendations and drive decisions. A growth mindset that drives the individual and team growth

Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

jobs.title: Lead Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.

OCI Architecture and Innovation team offers rare opportunities for creative, hands-on product owners with the expertise and passion to work on hard problems in distributed, highly available cloud services and virtualized infrastructure. Our TPMs have a significant business impact crafting and building new systems to power our customers business critical applications. You will work on delivery of various OCI services, including cloud migration service and leading enterprise hybrid cloud service.

In this Senior Principal Technical Program Management role, you will be working across a multi-functional team that understands our business and its objectives, to lead us through planning and designing technical solutions to solve the business’s problems in a very agile, fast-paced, and collaborative environment. The position relies heavily on influence rather than authority to drive projects.

You will define project scopes, plan and direct schedules while focusing on regular and timely delivery of value; organize and lead project status and working meetings; prepare and distribute progress reports; manage risks and issues; correct deviations from plans; and perform delivery planning for assigned projects.

You will independently drive the project from initiation through delivery. Organize the interdepartmental activities ensuring completion of the project/product on schedule and within budget constraints.

You will collaborate closely with our partners in program and product management to understand our customers and build the right solutions and products that makes their needs and businesses complete.

You should possess exceptional problem-solving skills, strong business and technical judgment, and notable experience collaborating in hybrid teams. You are a self-starter technical leader with a shown ability to execute both strategically and tactically, and someone who is excited to take on new projects.

You have strong interpersonal skills including mentoring, coaching, collaborating, and team building. You should be customer-focused with a passion for the cloud. You will partner closely with peers, developers, and customers to create solutions, while simultaneously evolving existing capabilities.

Responsibilities

Job Requirements
:

Excellent oral and written communications skills and experience interacting with both business and Development/Engineering staff at all levels including the executive level.
Solid analytical, planning, and interpersonal skills with an ability to handle competing demands.
Strong technical knowledge and understanding of business need with the ability to establish/maintain high level of customer trust and confidence.
Experience of software development process models as well as expert knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment.
Experience with technical design discussions and ability to summarize complex trade-offs and options in presentation and technical documentation
Ability to effectively represent engineering perspectives to partner organizations, product teams, and executive leadership.
Aptitude to work across and engage individuals and teams located across multiple geographies and or cultures.
Work with cross-functional teams to establish and maintain roadmaps, setting appropriate expectations while maintaining standards
Thrive and succeed in an innovative and fast-paced environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or conflicting priorities.
Work as a lead contributor individually, and as a team member, providing direction and mentoring to others as needed/requested.
Drive other obligations management duties, as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer sciences, software engineering, technology management, business management, or similar.
10+ years of experience as hands-on technical program manager; preferably in a related industry.
Advanced knowledge of the full life cycle of product development and experience launching and operating customer-facing cloud services
Experience efficiently and effectively communicating findings/progress to cross-functional teams, senior leadership, and the broader organizations, with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Self-driven problem solver; able to adapt and thrive in a dynamic, ambiguous, and customer-focused environment.
Highly analytical, technically proficient, and able to learn about new tools, software, and market opportunities quickly

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of program/project management, product design or related experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or relevant technical field or equivalent work experience
Thorough understanding of public cloud infrastructure services, such as Compute, Storage, Identity and Networking
Demonstrated knowledge of OCI, AWS, Azure or Google IaaS, SaaS and PaaS services.
Having DataCenter GPU infrastructure is desirable.

Senior Growth Product Manager – Adobe Experience Cloud

The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Cloud enables enterprises to deliver personalized, data-driven digital experiences at scale. We are seeking a Senior Growth Product Manager
to drive Product-Led Growth (PLG)
across Experience Cloud products by accelerating user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion.

This role is ideal for a growth leader with deep experience in B2B SaaS and Digital Marketing Technology
, who thrives at the intersection of product, experimentation and data. You will drive and implement growth strategies across key user journeys, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Go-To-Market teams to turn customer insight into scalable growth engines.

What You’ll Do

Growth Strategy & Lifecycle Management

Drive and evolve end-to-end growth strategies across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion for an Experience Cloud product.
Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using data, research and experimentation.
Develop and prioritize a growth roadmap tied to clear business impact.

Experimentation & Optimization

Design, launch, and analyze a high-velocity experimentation program across critical user journeys.
Drive rapid test-and-learn cycles that ensure rigorous experiment design by establishing clear hypotheses, calculating statistical power, and implementing appropriate guardrails.
Collaborate with engineering and data teams to build robust instrumentation for accurate measurement and monitoring. Oversee careful rollout strategies—including phased launches, A/B testing, and control groups—to minimize risk and improve actionable insights.

Technology-Based Growth Initiatives

Identify, prioritize, and ship product experiences powered by advanced technology that improve conversion and retention—e.g., personalization, predictive mentorship, and intelligent onboarding.
Use AI to speed up experiment ideation, hypothesis generation, copy/variant drafting, and analysis—while maintaining statistical rigor and human review.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with cross-functional leaders to co-develop and implement growth initiatives, navigating trade-offs and driving alignment across teams
Proven ability to influence product roadmaps and drive outcomes in a matrixed environment without direct authority
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning multiple teams around shared goals

Work in close coordination with:

Product Leaders who own core product to co-develop and implement a growth roadmap
Engineering to implement experimentation infrastructure
Design & UX Research to optimize onboarding and feature discovery
Marketing to align product growth levers with acquisition strategies
Finance & Data Science to quantify business impact

What You Need To Succeed

5+ years of Growth Product Management experience, with significant focus on experimentation-driven optimization.
Proven experience driving B2B Product-Led Growth in SaaS or Digital Marketing Technology platforms.
Experience implementing and executing experimentation tools.
Deep expertise in experimentation frameworks, behavioral analytics, funnel optimization, and cohort analysis.
Solid understanding of enterprise customer journeys, including self-serve, sales-assisted, and hybrid motions.
Fluency in applying AI to product discovery, experimentation, and growth workflows, with a commitment to continuous skill development.
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools for accelerating prototyping and insight generation.
Demonstrated ability to translate data and customer insight into shipped product experiences with measurable impact.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize insights into clear narratives that drive action.

Most Importantly

You value outcomes over activity, learning over certainty, and are deeply customer obsessed. You believe Product-Led Growth is an operating model, not a feature, and you thrive in environments where experimentation, insight, and collaboration drive impact.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to have you help shape the future of Experience Cloud.

jobs.description:
Job Description

OCI Strategic Customer Engineering is seeking an experienced Principal Program Manager with technical interests to lead large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that drive strategic outcomes across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure which span highly technical and business-centric delivery. This role is ideal for an accomplished program leader who thrives in highly technical environments, excels at navigating ambiguity, and has a proven ability to deliver complex programs from inception through execution.

You are a results-oriented leader who drives execution—not just coordination. You possess strong judgment, exceptional ownership, and a bias for action. You dig deep to master a space and understand it full. You build trusted partnerships across engineering, product management, operations, customer success, and executive leadership to align teams around common objectives and deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.

As a Principal Program Manager, you will lead programs that span multiple OCI organizations, helping teams prioritize, execute, and deliver initiatives that improve operational excellence, customer success, and strategic business objectives. The work is highly visible, fast-paced, and requires balancing technical complexity with operational and business complexity with organizational alignment.

Basic Qualifications

BS degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
7+ years of experience in Program Management, Software Engineering, Product Management, or related technical leadership roles
Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional programs across multiple engineering organizations
Strong understanding of cloud technologies, distributed systems, and software development lifecycles
Demonstrated ability to drive execution in complex, fast-moving environments with multiple stakeholders
Experience developing program plans, tracking execution, managing dependencies, and mitigating risks
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision making
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership
Proven ability to influence without direct authority and build consensus across diverse organizations
Strong customer focus with the ability to balance technical priorities and business objectives
Preferred Qualifications
MS degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field
10+ years of experience in Program Management or engineering leadership
Experience working with cloud-native architectures and large-scale distributed systems
Experience managing strategic customer programs or enterprise cloud initiatives
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and modern software development methodologies
Experience working directly with executive stakeholders and large enterprise customers

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

Program Leadership

Lead complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and successful delivery.
Define program goals, milestones, success metrics, and execution plans that align with organizational priorities.
Coordinate engineering, product management, operations, and customer success teams to deliver high-impact initiatives.
Drive program governance, status reporting, executive communications, and stakeholder alignment.
Identify program risks, dependencies, and execution challenges while developing proactive mitigation strategies.
Establish scalable program management processes and mechanisms that improve organizational execution.
Manage competing priorities and ensure successful delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Break down complex technical initiatives into manageable workstreams with clear ownership and accountability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Build strong partnerships across OCI engineering, product, operations, support, and executive leadership teams.
Drive alignment across organizations to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.
Facilitate technical and business discussions that enable informed decision-making and accelerate delivery.
Communicate program status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Foster collaboration across geographically distributed teams and organizations.

Operational Excellence

Identify opportunities to improve processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and increase organizational efficiency.
Develop repeatable mechanisms, dashboards, and reporting processes that improve program visibility and execution.
Lead post-launch reviews and continuous improvement efforts to enhance program delivery.
Support strategic planning activities, roadmap execution, and organizational prioritization.
Help teams scale effectively by implementing best practices for program management and operational excellence.

Customer & Business Impact

Partner with internal and external stakeholders to understand customer priorities and translate them into executable programs.
Drive initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
Balance customer needs, technical constraints, and organizational priorities while making informed tradeoff decisions.
Ensure programs deliver measurable value for both OCI and its strategic customers.

What Success Looks Like

Strategic initiatives are delivered on time, with high quality and strong cross-functional alignment.
Engineering, product, and business teams have clear visibility into priorities, risks, and execution progress.
Operational processes scale efficiently as the organization grows.
Executive stakeholders have confidence in program execution through consistent communication and measurable outcomes.
OCI Strategic Customer Engineering successfully delivers initiatives that improve customer experience, operational excellence, and business performance.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Platforms
jobs.description:
It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of hundreds of millions of people. Whether you’re looking to write mobile app code, engineer the servers behind our massive ad tech stacks, or develop algorithms to help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will have a huge impact on our business—and the world.

A Little About Us

At Yahoo, we operate thousands of services at global scale, reaching hundreds of millions of people around the world. Our internal developer platform powers these services and lets our developers build rapidly, securely, and with high quality. We are shifting from traditional infrastructure to an AI-augmented ecosystem
where speed and reliability are driven by intelligent automation.

A Lot About You

We are looking for a technically-sophisticated Sr. Product Manager (IC4) who views platforms as a lever for company-wide velocity. You have a deep commitment to developer experience and a track record of translating complex technical challenges into elegant, scalable solutions. You don't just follow a roadmap; you proactively identify how emerging technologies—specifically AI—can be used to reduce cognitive load for thousands of engineers .

Responsibilities

Lead the product strategy for critical platform pillars, including Cloud Runtime (K8s), Security, and Messaging, ensuring alignment with Yahoo’s broader engineering goals.
Identify and implement AI-driven efficiencies in day-to-day work, replacing manual feedback analysis and documentation tasks with AI-assisted workflows.
Deliver innovative platform solutions that reduce cognitive load, optimize costs, and improve the reliability of engineering systems at scale.
Utilize generative AI tools to synthesize insights from customer feedback (surveys, interviews, analytics) to accelerate the definition of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs).
Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader, evangelizing the platform's value and future roadmap to stakeholders.
Define and execute an AI-first product roadmap, ensuring models and autonomous agents are integrated to optimize platform performance and self-healing capabilities.
Collaborate with engineering, finance, and procurement to balance trade-offs between cost, technical feasibility, and speed to market.
Exercise judgment in when to rely on AI-augmented oversight versus manual validation for critical system changes.
Execute on internal go-to-market strategies to drive adoption and close the loop with our developer community.

Basic Qualifications

B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience (Requirement for candidate background check).
4+ years of experience in product management, specifically within cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or distributed systems.
7+ years of total industry experience in software services.
Proven ability to use AI productivity tools (e.g., Gemini, ChatGPT, or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate product discovery, documentation, and technical analysis.
Demonstrated technical depth in cloud services (AWS/GCP), Kubernetes, and modern architectural patterns.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to disambiguate complex problems for diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with prompt engineering or structured interaction with AI models to assist in data analysis or system diagnostics.
Direct experience with security platforms or database-as-a-service (DBaaS) offerings.
Prior experience as a software engineer or architect, with a focus on building tools for other developers.
Interest in staying current on emerging AI tools and proactively suggesting improvements to internal platform workflows.

The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity.

At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

We're looking for an operational leader to partner with engineering, finance and accounting operational leaders to transform Anthropic's global order-to-cash (O2C) function. Our business is scaling faster than the processes and systems that support it, across direct enterprise contracts, consumption-based commercial models, and third-party cloud marketplaces. This role is a key partner with the end-to-end redesign: how orders are structured and provisioned, how transactions flow through our systems, how revenue is billed and recognized, and how all of it stays controlled and auditable as volume compounds.

This is a builder's role with a broad remit. You'll help set the multi-year Global O2C roadmap and then manage the critical aspects such as designing front-to-back processes, standing up automation and AI-driven tooling where manual work doesn't scale. Facilitating programs that cut across Finance, Go-to-Market, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and Engineering.

If you're energized by ambiguous, high-consequence operational problems at a company at the forefront of AI development, we'd like to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Global O2C Strategy & Transformation

Be a key contributor to the vision, roadmap, and execution of Anthropic's global order-to-cash transformation, spanning order management, provisioning, billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition
Assess the current state end-to-end, identify the structural constraints on scale, and sequence a prioritized program of work with clear milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes
Build the operating metrics and reporting that make O2C performance legible to leadership — cycle times, error and rework rates, touchless transaction rates, revenue leakage, and cost to serve
Serve as the senior operational voice in commercial and pricing workflows, translating what the business wants to sell into what we can actually transact, bill, and recognize

Process Design & Operational Excellence

Design scalable, controlled processes from the ground up, applying structured process design and continuous improvement methodology rather than incremental patching
Standardize and harmonize O2C processes globally across regions, entities, channels, and business models, eliminating the one-off exception handling that accumulates in high-growth environments
Establish clear operating rhythms, escalation paths, and service levels across the quote-to-cash lifecycle, with documentation that holds up as the team and transaction volume grow
Build the operational infrastructure that lets the function absorb order-of-magnitude growth without a proportional increase in headcount
Build compliance monitoring into the systems, including SOX controls, themselves so that controls scale with volume rather than headcount

Systems, Automation & AI

Help drive the O2C systems architecture and roadmap in partnership with O2C Leadership, Engineering and GTM Systems, defining requirements, prioritizing investment, and holding the line on scalable solutions over point fixes
Deploy AI and automation to drive real leverage across the function — automated exception handling and reconciliation, self-service reporting and anomaly detection, and continuous rather than sample-based control monitoring
Lead global automation strategy and evaluation across billing, contracting, and ERP platforms, and drive the implementations and migrations that follow

Cross-Functional Leadership

Drive alignment and results across Revenue Accounting, Deal Desk, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Engineering, influencing outcomes without relying on direct authority
Partner with high-performing operations teams, setting standards, developing talent, and scaling capacity through a mix of employees, contractors, and partners
Communicate progress, trade-offs, risks, and decisions crisply to executive stakeholders, and surface issues early with a recommended path forward

You may be a good fit if you have

10+ years of progressive experience leading operational transformations within Revenue Operations, Billing Operations, or other finance operational teams at high-growth SaaS/technology companies, including experience leading cross-functionally
Expert understanding of process design, cross-functional project management, and scaling systems — including using AI to drive automation, reporting, and compliance
Project management certification (PMP) or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
Expert understanding of quote-to-cash processes for SaaS, covering both subscription and consumption-based business models across B2B products
Extensive experience with contracting systems, billing platforms, and ERP systems (e.g., Salesforce, Stripe, NetSuite, Oracle, Workday Financials, Zuora)
A proven track record leading large-scale strategic and automation initiatives end-to-end, from business case through implementation and adoption
Experience building and developing operations teams
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, or a related field

Strong candidates may also have

Experience serving both B2C and B2B customers; especially with consumption-based, subscription billing models through to collections
Experience with go-to-market, deal desk and revenue operations organizations
Experience designing and implementing processes with robust internal controls, segregation of duties frameworks and flow of financial transactions in high-growth environments
Understanding of AI industry business models and enterprise customer needs

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$230,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management (External Services), AWS Identity & Secrets
jobs.description:
Description

Every application has to answer two questions before it can do anything: who are you, and what's the secret that proves it? You'll shape how AWS customers answer both — at a scale measured in hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

We're looking for a Senior Product Management leader to set the direction for two of AWS's most foundational security services — Amazon Cognito (customer identity and authentication) and AWS Secrets Manager (managing the secrets and credentials applications rely on) — and to build the team behind them. Each service has its own customers, its own roadmap, and its own reason to exist. Your job is to lead the product team across both, sharpen the strategy for each, and find the places where the two add up to more than the sum of their parts. You'll own the whole story — vision, roadmap, go-to-market, and pricing — and you'll ground your calls in data, not opinions. It's a high-visibility role: the roadmap you own gets reviewed by AWS's most senior leaders, and you'll be working at the center of how identity and secrets are evolving for the next generation of applications and AWS workload identity.

Key job responsibilities

Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Cognito and Secrets Manager — growing each as a first-class product, and spotting the bets that connect them.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers — set the bar for the craft, help people build their careers, and raise the ceiling on what the team can take on.
Own go-to-market and pricing — partner with sales, marketing, and field teams on how you launch and drive adoption, and make the pricing calls that shape how customers buy and grow.
Run the business by the numbers — decide which metrics matter, partner with your analytics and business intelligence team to build the reporting behind them, and let the data drive where you invest.
Turn customer signal into the bets worth funding — figure out where the next wave of growth comes from, and make the case that gets it resourced.
Translate what customers need into what engineering builds — write the narratives, requirements, and user stories that give the team an unambiguous target, and stay with it from idea to launch.
Make the hard prioritization calls across a wide set of partners — engineering, security, field, and partner teams — clearing roadblocks and building the buy-in to move.
Bring senior leaders along — earn agreement on the vision and the plan at the most senior levels, and never let leadership get surprised on risk.
Stay close to the craft — this is a hands-on product leader, not a manager who's stepped away from the work. Expect to spend part of your time building product yourself.

A day in the life

You start the morning on a customer escalation about rotating secrets at scale, and turn it into a roadmap question your team digs into together. By the afternoon you're in an adoption dashboard with your analytics partner, deciding whether a recent pricing change is actually working — then pressure-testing the story with engineering before a leadership review. You're just as comfortable in the doc, in the data, and in the room.

About The Team

We build the services that let applications answer two basic questions: who is this, and can I trust the secret that proves it? Amazon Cognito signs users in for developers worldwide, and AWS Secrets Manager protects the credentials their applications depend on — both at enormous scale.

We're a self-contained product team: product managers, engineers, a customer-facing solutions architect, and analytics partners, so an idea can travel from a customer's problem to a shipped feature without leaving the group. We start from customer signal, argue from data, and stay hands-on. Our ambition: make identity and secrets the secure, obvious default for every builder on AWS.

This includes driving low-latency multi-lingual human-like conversational quality and self-healing intelligence that detects where AI fails, optimizes knowledge, simulates before deployment, and learns continuously from production traffic. We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems while designing beautiful simple user experiences. You will lead a team of product managers developing the next generation of generative AI infused end-customer self-service capabilities and drive the design and delivery of high-scale resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus. Partnering closely with the Vice President and executive team, this role drives a full-service, customer-centric business focused on delivering exceptional outcomes across the entire customer journey, from project award through execution, project completion, and long-term customer retention.

The Brand Director serves as the primary business leader responsible for aligning commercial and order and project execution functions to support profitable growth and operational excellence. This role requires extensive experience with large, complex façade projects and a deep understanding of architectural aluminum systems, project delivery processes, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and customer experience.

The Brand Director provides direct leadership for Estimating, Client Services, Project Management, Drafting, and Order Management while collaborating closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Manufacturing to ensure successful project execution and customer outcomes.

This role was created to lead the transformation of the Wausau Window & Wall business from a functionally managed organization to an integrated, customer-centric business with end-to-end accountability for customer experience, operational performance, and profitable growth.

Business Leadership & Growth

Align commercial and operational strategies to support customer success, growth with existing customers, and acquisition of new customers.

Establish and drive performance metrics related to customer satisfaction, project execution, operational efficiency, revenue, and profitability.
Identify and implement opportunities that improve business performance, customer value, and market position.

Customer & Standard Order/Project Delivery Leadership

Provide direct leadership for Estimating, Client Services, Project Management, Drafting, and Order Management.
Ensure successful execution of large, complex façade projects through effective project planning, risk management, resource allocation, customer communication, and cross-functional coordination.
Align commercial, operational, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain functions to achieve business and customer objectives.
Serve as the senior executive contact for strategic customers and critical project escalations.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

Develop high-performing teams and future leaders through talent assessment, coaching, accountability, succession planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Assess organizational capabilities and talent needs to ensure the business has the leadership, technical expertise, and execution capacity required to achieve strategic and operational objectives.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Transformation Leadership

Lead organizational transformation and cross-functional business improvement initiatives that enhance scalability, customer experience, operational effectiveness, and financial performance.
Build alignment across functions that have historically operated independently and establish an integrated operating model with clear ownership and accountability throughout the customer journey.
Simplify processes, reduce internal handoffs, and remove organizational barriers that inhibit customer outcomes and business performance.
Create clarity, alignment, and engagement while leading the organization through change.

Position Goals

Support delivery of annual revenue, profitability, and growth objectives for Wausau Window & Wall.
Improve customer satisfaction and retention throughout the project lifecycle.
Strengthen coordination and execution across estimating, drafting, project management, order management, and client services functions.
Grow market share within targeted architectural and commercial construction segments.
Establish Wausau Window & Wall as the industry's preferred partner for complex façade and fenestration solutions.
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Successfully transform the organization into an integrated, scalable, customer-centric business with end-to-end ownership of the customer experience.
Support Architectural Metals in building a service-driven organization capable of sustainable long-term growth.

Strong strategic and business leadership capabilities.
Deep understanding of project delivery from order intake through project completion.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing revenue, profitability, and business performance.
Ability to build relationships and influence across customers, teams, and executive leadership.
Proven ability to align teams and drive accountability across multiple functions.
Excellent listening and interpersonal skills.
Excellent Verbal and written communication skills.
Strong mechanical orientation.
Excellent organizational skills.

Description

Amazon Devices is seeking a senior marketing leader to architect and scale an integrated marketing operating system across our consumer technology brand portfolio. This role is the connective tissue between strategy and execution — responsible for building the systems, processes, and operating models that drive unified demand generation, brand coherence, and measurable customer growth across one of the world's largest consumer technology businesses.

This is not a traditional campaign leadership role. We are looking for a modern marketing operator — a system builder who can design scalable marketing infrastructure across product lines, unify disparate teams and disciplines under a single operating model, and deliver business outcomes with speed and precision. The right leader combines deep marketing expertise with an AI-native mindset, a product-thinking approach to building repeatable capabilities, and zero distance from the customer. They are equally comfortable defining strategy and building the workflows, measurement frameworks, and AI-enabled mechanisms that make strategy durable and scalable.

Key job responsibilities

Architect and own the integrated marketing operating system—establishing scalable frameworks for planning, creative development, media execution, and measurement that drive organization-wide leverage
Design and lead end-to-end integrated marketing strategies spanning brand, performance, media, creative, product marketing, lifecycle, and channel, bringing disparate functions into a unified execution model
Build the connective tissue between brands, channels, and customer touchpoints to deliver a cohesive narrative while preserving individual positioning
Own the customer-facing narrative that connects product value to portfolio-level benefit, ensuring customers understand not just what each product does, but what they gain when offerings work together
Operate as a senior strategic partner to product and business leadership, translating customer insights, market dynamics, and product roadmaps into high-impact marketing plans
Drive a culture of high-velocity decision-making across competing priorities, stakeholders, and timelines—moving with urgency while maintaining strategic coherence
Establish measurement frameworks and feedback loops that connect marketing activity to business outcomes with speed and accountability
Leverage AI, automation, and emerging agentic tools to fundamentally transform how marketing is planned, produced, and optimized—building new models where no established playbook yet exists
Build, coach, and scale a high-performing, cross-functional marketing organization across brand strategy, media, creative, content, product marketing, and lifecycle functions
Drive cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, sales, and category teams, influencing outcomes without direct authority across organizational boundaries

15+ years of progressive experience in marketing with direct accountability for integrated brand and performance marketing strategy at scale
10+ years building and leading cross-discipline marketing teams across brand, media, creative, and demand generation functions
Demonstrated track record building marketing systems and operating models—not just executing campaigns, but designing the infrastructure that enables repeatable execution
Experience operating in highly matrixed environments requiring integration of multiple brands, product lines, or business units with competing priorities
Experience with organizational transformation or change management at scale
Experience managing large marketing budgets with demonstrated accountability for ROI, efficiency, and growth

MBA or advanced degree
Demonstrated AI fluency with evidence of integrating AI and agentic workflows into marketing operations, creative production, content operations, and decision-making as a native operator
Background in marketing operations, growth, digital transformation, product-led GTM, or AI transformation functions—provided strong marketing credibility accompanies it
Deep expertise across marketing verticals (brand strategy, performance media, creative, product marketing, lifecycle) with a strategic understanding of how they integrate
Track record of systems thinking: designing frameworks and operating models that scale across products, geographies, and channels
Product-minded approach to building repeatable capabilities—evidence of creating durable mechanisms that outlast individual programs or campaigns
Examples of high-velocity decision-making in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where speed was a deliberate operating choice
Experience bringing together disparate organizations with different incentives, building alignment and delivering outcomes through influence
Demonstrated zero-distance orientation: using customer signals, data, and direct engagement to inform strategy in real time rather than relying on layers of abstraction
Experience leading through significant organizational change, transformation, or rapid scale

Job Description

Champions the prioritization of products and features by evaluating business value, feasibility, and user needs, ensuring alignment with Oracle's goals and strategies. Leads the engagement of key strategic customers, non-customers, partners and industry analysts to obtain market information and discover opportunities for product portfolio/product area. Establishes strategies to identify customer needs and market opportunities, guiding teams to develop highly complex solutions and validate them. Provides strategic guidance to team members on maintaining the roadmap for multiple products/features, drives delivery excellence, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Acts as an innovation leader within the Line of Business (LOB) and sets the overall strategy and direction of products, driving initiatives and setting the long-term vision. Champions the adoption of new methodologies for new feature development. Drives the sharing of strategic insights with cross-functional partners and Lines of Business (LOB). Owns transformative business impact across LOB and oversees standards of success metrics criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products. Champions the customer's needs throughout the product lifecycle and prioritizes critical customer issues. Proactively seeks out customers to gather feedback and align product capabilities with highly valued customers' business goals. Leads the go-to-market efforts, strategically recruits and supports key early adopters, and defines and tracks product adoption metrics for multiple product lines to drive adoption and product improvement.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Analysis – Market Analysis:

–Champions the prioritization of products/features based on evaluations of business value, feasibility, and internal and/or external user needs.

–Works with highly valued customers to ensure seamless alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, and Oracle's goals and strategy.

–Champions the analysis of market trends and the competitive landscape to set strategic and competitive positioning.

–Leads the engagements of key strategic customers, non-customers, partners, and industry analysts to obtain market information and discover opportunities for the product portfolio/product area.

Product Analysis – Solution Identification:

–Establishes strategies for identifying customers' unmet or unknown needs, market opportunities, and regulatory requirements.

–Influences internal teams in developing problem statements for highly complex products and forming data-driven hypotheses for breakthrough new products.

–Owns and champions the solutioning process by strategically partnering with internal and external stakeholders to identify solutions.

–Spearheads the evaluation and validation of different solutions to make informed decisions on enhancing existing products/features or introducing new products/features.

–Leads the creation and maintenance of critical and complex solution artifacts (e.g., regulatory requirements, functional and non-functional requirements).

Product Ownership – Product Development and Roadmapping:

–Drives the Line of Business’s (LOB) product lifecycle approach, setting industry standards for excellence.

–Provides strategic guidance to team members on maintaining the roadmap for multiple products/features, aligning them with Oracle’s vision and market demands.

–Establishes feature requirements, resources, and best practices, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and empowering internal stakeholders.

–Takes a leadership role in driving delivery excellence with key stakeholders, managing risks and resolving complex issues to ensure project success.

–Interprets existing metrics (e.g., Service Requests, bugs raised, customer feedback, customer volumes) and market insights, driving strategic decision-making and optimizing product development in dynamic environments.

–Sets expectations for product quality by leading the creation and review of user stories and acceptance criteria.

–Reviews and shapes features or experiences prioritized in the roadmap, strategically aligning them with success criteria and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

Product Ownership – Product Leadership and Influence:

–Acts as an innovation leader within the Line of Business (LOB) and sets the overall strategy and direction of products, driving initiatives and long-term vision.

–Directs the development of products to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals.

–Champions the adoption of new methodologies for new feature development, leveraging agile and continuous-delivery practices.

Alignment and Collaboration:

–Drives the sharing of strategic insights with cross-functional partners and Lines of Business (LOB), ensuring alignment and fostering a culture of collaboration.

–Anticipates and addresses potential pushback from stakeholders, leveraging extensive subject matter expertise and data-driven arguments to drive consensus and decision-making.

–Guides collaboration efforts with engineering and senior colleagues to execute innovative solutions tied to OKRs and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

–Takes full ownership of driving transformative business impact across Lines of Business (LOB), overseeing success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products/features.

–Provides insight into parameters for user testing and champions the iteration and enhancement of products based on test results.

Customer-Centricity:

–Champions the customer's needs throughout the product lifecycle, proactively anticipating and addressing complex customer needs.

–Proactively seeks out customers to gather comprehensive feedback and conducts extensive research to understand their experiences with Oracle's products and services.

–Collaborates strategically with highly valued customers to align Oracle product capabilities with customers' evolving business goals.

–Leads efforts to capture, analyze, and synthesize intricate customer requirements, defining new product capabilities and driving the development of feature designs.

–Provides subject matter expertise and guidance to ensure products deliver exceptional value and exceed product consumer expectations following implementations.

–Reviews and prioritizes critical customer issues to ensure customer satisfaction and product quality, partnering with product development for advanced resolution.

Product Release – Go-to-Market:

–Leads the development of release overviews, field presentations, and demos for the field team, providing guidance to junior staff as needed.

–Strategically recruits and provides robust support to key early adopters to validate and enhance product solutions.

–Drives the development of thorough and detailed user documentation, providing expert-level oversight as needed.

–Defines and tracks key product metrics to monitor adoption for multiple product lines, leveraging data insights to drive product improvement.

–Presents product demonstrations to highly valued internal and/or external customers and partners, industry analysts, and field teams, showcasing the innovation and value of new releases.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.

–Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.

–Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success.

–Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

–Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.

–Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drive the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

–Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization.

–Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).

–Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.

–Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams.

–Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.

–Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.

–Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

–Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy.

–Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

Owns the inbound product strategy, roadmap, and execution for OCI DevOps tooling, translating customer, developer, and operator needs into high-impact product capabilities. Evaluates opportunities using customer value, technical feasibility, market dynamics, and alignment with OCI strategy.

Engages directly with enterprise customers, prospects, partners, field teams, and industry analysts to understand DevOps workflows, pain points, and emerging needs across areas such as CI/CD, infrastructure automation, developer experience, release management, observability, security, and platform engineering. Synthesizes qualitative feedback and product data into clear problem statements, prioritized requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Leads discovery, validation, and roadmap planning for multiple products and features. Partners closely with engineering, UX, architecture, security, documentation, support, and go-to-market teams to define product requirements, make informed tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality releases. Establishes success metrics—including adoption, engagement, reliability, time-to-value, and customer satisfaction—and uses them to guide iteration and investment decisions.

Serves as the voice of the customer throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring OCI DevOps tooling is intuitive, interoperable, secure, scalable, and aligned with how modern software teams build, deploy, and operate services. Drives customer escalations and usability improvements to resolution, while proactively identifying opportunities to simplify developer and operator workflows.

Supports go-to-market readiness by developing product positioning, launch materials, demos, early-adopter programs, and field enablement. Builds strong relationships with design partners and customers, tracks adoption and feedback after launch, and continuously improves the product experience and roadmap based on real-world usage.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Market Insight, and Discovery

Own inbound product strategy for OCI DevOps tooling, grounding priorities in customer impact, business value, technical feasibility, product data, and OCI strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of modern software-delivery and platform-engineering practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, release orchestration, developer experience, cloud-native operations, security, and observability.
Engage enterprise customers, design partners, prospects, field teams, partners, and analysts to identify unmet needs, workflow friction, emerging trends, and competitive opportunities.
Analyze market, ecosystem, and competitive signals to inform product positioning, investment decisions, and differentiated capabilities.
Translate customer and market insights into clear problem statements, opportunity assessments, hypotheses, and product requirements.
Identify relevant security, compliance, reliability, and operational requirements for enterprise DevOps workflows.

Product Definition, Roadmap, and Execution

Own the roadmap and backlog for assigned OCI DevOps products and features, ensuring clear alignment to customer needs, business priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements such as scalability, availability, performance, security, and interoperability.
Partner with engineering, design, architecture, security, documentation, support, and program management to drive discovery, solution design, delivery, launch, and iteration.
Make informed prioritization and tradeoff decisions across new features, technical debt, customer escalations, usability improvements, and operational quality.
Establish product success criteria and track metrics such as adoption, activation, engagement, retention, time-to-value, deployment velocity, reliability, support trends, and customer satisfaction.
Use qualitative feedback and quantitative data—including usage telemetry, service requests, defects, and customer escalations—to continuously improve the product experience.
Manage delivery risks, dependencies, and decision points; communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

Technical Product Leadership and Cross-Functional Alignment

Serve as a credible technical partner to engineering teams, participating in architecture and design discussions to ensure proposed solutions solve customer problems effectively.
Drive product decisions across interconnected OCI services, ensuring a cohesive experience for developers, DevOps engineers, SREs, platform engineers, and cloud administrators.
Influence product direction through customer evidence, data, and clear narratives—not solely through organizational authority.
Build alignment across engineering, field, support, security, marketing, and senior leadership; anticipate stakeholder concerns and resolve disagreement constructively.
Define and facilitate customer validation, usability testing, preview programs, and post-launch learning loops.

Customer Advocacy and Go-to-Market

Act as the voice of the customer throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring OCI DevOps tooling is secure, scalable, intuitive, interoperable, and suitable for enterprise adoption.
Maintain relationships with customers and design partners; recruit early adopters to validate new concepts, previews, and releases.
Triage and prioritize customer issues, partnering with engineering and support teams to drive timely resolution and communicate product direction.
Support product launches through release narratives, demos, field enablement, sales collateral, product documentation, and customer-facing presentations.
Track adoption and customer outcomes after launch, using findings to improve onboarding, documentation, positioning, and future roadmap investments.

Core Responsibilities
Planning and Execution

Independently manage moderately complex product initiatives, balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.
Maintain clear plans, milestones, decisions, dependencies, and delivery expectations across multiple concurrent features or workstreams.
Provide product direction and prioritization to teams; coordinate work without assuming direct people-management responsibility.

Collaboration and Problem Solving

Work inclusively across diverse teams and perspectives to develop practical, customer-centered solutions.
Analyze ambiguous problems using customer evidence, technical context, product data, and business considerations.
Escalate material risks early, with a clear assessment, options, recommendation, and expected impact.

Continuous Learning and Improvement

Stay current on DevOps, cloud-native development, AI-assisted software delivery, platform engineering, security, and enterprise cloud trends.
Improve product management practices, discovery processes, feedback loops, and team operating mechanisms.
Mentor junior product managers or partner team members as appropriate, and contribute to hiring through interviews and candidate assessments.

Description

Are you passionate about helping organizations manage governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) at cloud scale? AWS is building a new AI-powered GRC service that delivers continuous compliance, real-time risk quantification, and governance for AI agent workloads. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to own and drive critical product areas as we scale this service for enterprise adoption.

About The Opportunity

The GRC market is $60B+ and undergoing a fundamental transformation. Point-in-time audits are becoming untenable as enterprises operate across multi-cloud and hybrid environments that change daily. AI agents are proliferating faster than compliance programs can adapt. No incumbent GRC vendor has a credible solution for continuous, AI-native governance. AWS is uniquely positioned to win here — and we're building the team to make it happen.

In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, requirements, and go-to-market for a core set of capabilities within a new cloud-native GRC service. You will work backwards from enterprise GRC buyers — compliance officers, risk managers, CISOs, and audit teams — to define what we build and why. You will partner with engineering, science, UX, marketing, sales, and legal to deliver capabilities that win in a competitive and rapidly evolving market.

This is a high-ownership role. You will define the product vision for your area, author PRFAQs and requirements documents, make pricing and packaging decisions, and drive adoption post-launch. You will operate at the intersection of deep domain expertise in compliance/audit/risk and strong technical product management fundamentals.

Key job responsibilities

Leverage deep audit and compliance expertise — direct experience conducting, managing, or overseeing audits — to define product requirements that solve real practitioner pain points

Own the product strategy and roadmap for a core domain within a new AI-powered GRC service — from vision through delivery and adoption

Work backwards from enterprise GRC customers to define requirements, acceptance criteria, and prioritization

Author PRFAQs, pricing narratives, and requirements documents that align engineering execution with customer outcomes

Partner with engineering leads to make architecture tradeoffs, scope MVPs, and drive sprint-level execution through a multi-pod organization

Work cross-functionally with marketing, field sales, solution architects, professional services, and GSI partners to drive enterprise adoption

Represent the service in customer meetings, industry events, and executive reviews

On a typical day, you might review customer feedback from a Fortune 500 enterprise, author a requirements for a new capability, meet with engineering to finalize scope for the next release train, join a customer call with a solution architect to understand an auditor's workflow, analyze service telemetry to identify adoption blockers, and sync with marketing on positioning for an upcoming industry event. CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or equivalent professional certifications
Experience evaluating, selecting, or implementing GRC platforms for enterprise organizations

Amazon Devices & Services has committed to an ambitious path toward net-zero carbon. Getting there means measuring, reducing, and eliminating the carbon footprint of our products at a scale and speed that manual processes simply can't match. Our team builds the software, platforms, and intelligent systems that make that possible — turning slow, manual sustainability analysis into fast, AI-assisted work, so our scientists and program managers can focus on the highest-impact carbon-reduction work.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Technical to own a portfolio of the products and platforms at the center of this mission. You'll work hand-in-hand with a team of software engineers who specialize in AI development, and you'll own products end to end — from customer problem to shipped, adopted, and measurable capability. This is a builder's role for someone energized by ambiguity, comfortable going deep with engineers and scientists, and motivated by impact you can measure in both real-world carbon reduction and time given back to experts.

What makes this role exciting

About

A meaningful part of this portfolio is about defining and launching AI products. Partnering with engineers who specialize in AI software development, you'll shape and ship capabilities such as:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Microsoft 365 carries a large share of the world's business communication, and almost none of it reaches a mailbox without passing through Substrate Transport. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a core area of that pipeline: to set its direction, define what we build, and carry the work through to an outcome that customers and the business can measure.

This role suits someone comfortable with depth. The problems are technical, the systems are hyper scale and long-lived, and the right answer usually depends on evidence you go and find yourself. In return you get genuine ownership of a service every Microsoft 365 customer depends on, and a team that expects you to lead rather than coordinate.

Substrate Transport is the engine that routes, filters, and delivers the messages that flow through Microsoft 365. Our mission is to move mail reliably, safely, and efficiently at planetary scale, and to give the workloads built on the platform they can depend on without having to reason about the plumbing underneath.

The team's scope follows the full path a message takes: submission and ingestion, routing and categorization, policy and compliance enforcement, hygiene and anti-abuse controls, and final delivery to a mailbox or an external destination. It also covers the connector and hybrid surfaces that customers configure themselves, the volumetric and throttling controls that keep the service healthy under load, and the continued modernization of infrastructure that predates the cloud era.

This position is based at the Redmond campus with 3 days per week work in the office and 2 days per week work from home. Domestic relocation assistance is available.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

You will own a focus area within the transport pipeline from definition through shipped outcome, working alongside engineering leads, partner PM teams across Exchange Online and Microsoft 365, and the service engineers who keep mail flowing every day.

Define the product

Set the strategy and roadmap for your area of the pipeline, grounded in customer promises rather than in a feature list. Write the specs that engineering builds from, state the hypothesis each investment is testing, and say plainly how you will know whether it worked.

Align the business and technical strategy for the area, including how it fits the broader Substrate and Microsoft 365 direction, and make the trade-offs between short-term relief and the long-term architecture the service needs.

Drive execution

Run your area through the full engineering lifecycle: scope, safe rollout, telemetry, and the operational readiness a service of this size demands. Anticipate the dependency that will slip before it slips, and hold a mitigation ready when it does.

Carry security, privacy, compliance, and accessibility obligations as part of the definition of done rather than as a late review gate, and make sure changes to mail flow are validated before they reach customers at scale.

Own the outcome

Own one or more service or business metrics for your area and build the roadmap that moves them. Go directly to the telemetry, message traces, and large-scale data the service produces, and use both the quantitative and the qualitative signal to frame the problem before proposing a solution.

Represent the area to leadership, to partner teams, and to customers, simplifying a complex system enough for a decision to be made without flattening the detail that matters.

Lead the team around you

Raise the bar for how the team works: sharpen other people's specs with real feedback, mentor less experienced product managers, and establish patterns your teammates choose to copy because they make the work go faster.

Resolve problems that need cross-organizational alignment, securing commitment from teams that do not report to you and that may not share your goals.
