jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Technical, QoS & Performance , Leo Network Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical (PMT) to own the Quality of Service (QoS) and Performance domain within Leo Networking. In this role, you will define the products and features that ensure Leo delivers on its performance promises — from core performance assurance to traffic shaping and congestion management algorithms. You will work at the intersection of networking engineering, satellite systems, and customer experience to build differentiated, measurable, and enforceable Performance & QoS capabilities.

This is a high-visibility role that requires deep technical acumen in networking, strong product sense, and the ability to influence across engineering, business, and leadership. You will own the Performance and QoS roadmap from concept through launch, write PRFAQs and technical requirements, and represent the customer’s performance expectations in every architectural decision.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end Performance and QoS product strategy for Leo, including traffic classification, prioritization, shaping, and congestion management.

Define and drive the performance metrics framework — establishing SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs that govern throughput, latency, jitter, and packet loss across the Leo network.

Partner with Principal Engineers and SDEs to prioritize and implement network performance capabilities and enforcement mechanisms across the satellite, ground gateway, and SDN layers.

Write PRFAQs, technical narratives, and requirement documents to secure resources and align leadership on the network performance roadmap.

Collaborate with sales, demand management, and capacity management to gather customer performance requirements and translate them into product features.

Define acceptance criteria and performance gates for new feature performance capabilities, ensuring QoS compliance before customer-facing releases.

Work cross-functionally with the Beam Planning, SDN, and Satellite Operations teams to optimize resource allocation and minimize latency, packet loss, and congestion across the constellation.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with a review of overnight performance dashboards — checking throughput, latency percentiles, and congestion events across active beams and ground gateways. You notice a pattern in peak-hour congestion for a specific geographic region and draft a quick analysis to bring to your engineering sync.

Mid-morning, you’re in a design review with the SDN team, debating the trade-offs of a new traffic shaping algorithm that could improve P99 latency for enterprise customers but may impact other traffic. You push for a data-driven approach, proposing an A/B test framework to validate the change in a controlled environment.

After lunch, you’re on a call with an enterprise customer’s network architect who wants to understand how Amazon Leo’s quality of service compares to their existing MPLS-based WAN, and how to best integrate Leo connectivity in parallel to their existing MPLS WAN behind an SDWAN appliance. You walk them through Leo’s service plan tiers, SLA commitments, and the telemetry they’ll have access to.

In the afternoon, you’re drafting the PRFAQ for the next phase of network performance— introducing dynamic bandwidth allocation that adapts to real-time demand patterns. You collaborate with a principal engineer to ensure the technical approach is sound, and align with sales, capacity, and finance teams on the financial impact. You end the day with a quick sync with the Beam Planning team to review capacity forecasts for the upcoming month.

About The Team

The Leo Connectivity Product team is responsible for the end-to-end networking stack that delivers connectivity from customer terminals through the satellite constellation to ground gateways and back to the terrestrial internet. We work across the control plane and data plane services that make Leo a carrier-grade networking provider.

Our team culture values deep technical curiosity, customer obsession, and a bias for action. We operate with a startup mentality inside Amazon — moving fast, iterating on data, and shipping capabilities that directly impact customer experience. We are builders who are energized by the challenge of delivering consistent, high-performance networking from a dynamic constellation of LEO satellites.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe the best products come from teams with varied perspectives and experiences.

Basic Qualifications

Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
Experience defining and managing SLAs/SLOs for networking or cloud services.
Strong understanding of network performance fundamentals: IP DSCP, L2 CoS, traffic classification, marking, shaping, network queuing disciplines, fair queueing, CoDel, WRED, bufferbloat
Track record of writing technical requirements documents, PRFAQs, or product specifications.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems
Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own
Experience with satellite communications, LEO networking, or space-based systems.
Experience in customer-facing technical product role at a cloud provider or telecommunications company.
Familiarity with AWS networking services (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPC) and how enterprise customers build hybrid networks.

Description

Are you passionate about languages and translation? Are you motivated to have a direct impact on customers around the world? Do you have a tech background and love finding creative solutions to challenging problems? Amazon's Translation Services team is responsible for building the tools and features that support the localization and translation needs of all Amazon businesses. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to create the vision, strategy, and roadmap that will continually improve and scale our services and deliver the best experience for our customers in their preferred language. If you are passionate about building equitable experiences for worldwide customers and are undaunted by large scope, let’s talk.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager - Technical, you will own the strategy and execution of one of the product charters within the Translation Services space. You will partner with stakeholders across the business -- content owners, localization program managers, and translators -- to understand their biggest problems and opportunities, then build a backlog of features to address those problems. Job Description

Independently partners with science, engineering, and product teams to translate business needs into a clear research plan and production-ready solutions. Leads end-to-end applied research: surveying state of the art, preparing high-quality datasets, running POCs/experiments, and designing, training, and optimizing ML/AI models and solution architectures. Writes reliable, well-documented code, following best practices for version control, testing, and deployment, and collaborate closely to ship, monitor, and iterate on models in production. Distill insights for diverse audiences, contribute patents, white papers, and technical docs, and demonstrate deep expertise in a business-critical research area. Engage with the broader scientific community through publications, peer review, and internal collaborations.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Solution Identification:

–Independently collaborates with science, engineering, and product teams to identify business and product needs to create and implement solutions, promote innovation, and drive model implementations.

–Independently performs literature reviews and state-of-the-art analyses to understand the problem that needs to be solved.

–Creates a science plan to address product and/or business problems.

–Serves as a leading contributor on the identification of solutions based on the scientific process (e.g., including modeling approaches, evaluation techniques, data collections).

Solution Development – Applied Research:

–Develops and pilots research proofs-of-concept (POCs) or research experiments to demonstrate the feasibility of proposed solutions, gather supporting evidence, and secure resources for applied research.

–Independently identifies and prepares datasets for use in applied research. Ensures datasets meet quality standards, and identifies gaps in the data.

–Contributes to the design of and conducts research on new theories, tools, and methodologies to transfer and apply state-of-the-art technologies into products and services or make advancements in the field.

Solution Development:

–Designs, develops, and optimizes ML and AI technologies, such as model training/fine-tuning and computation optimizations.

–Designs and reviews the architecture of ML and AI solutions, such as data, model, training, and evaluation, employing best practices.

Solution Development – Articulating Research Insights:

–Independently identifies meaningful insights from data and metadata sources from analysis and experiments.

–Interprets and communicates insights and findings to cross-level and cross-functional audience.

–Creates patents, white papers, or other technical documentation related to applied research outcomes.

Solution Delivery – Coding and Documentation:

–Develops efficient, bug-free, medium-complexity code from scratch, and properly maintains and organizes existing codebase.

–Implements best practices for version control, code review, and code delivery/deployment.

–Builds and maintains professional documentation for technical processes (experimentation, data collection and analyses, model building).

–Tests and reviews code for bugs.

Solution Delivery:

–Collaborates with fellow technical teams to ensure the successful and timely delivery of solutions and integration of services.

–Collaborates with software engineers and/or machine learning engineers to deploy solutions into production environments.

–Participates in the peer review of solutions prior to delivery.

–Coordinates with team members for the delivery of solutions.

–Ensures delivered solutions successfully solve product and/or business problems.

–Independently collaborates with operational teams to evaluate and monitor solutions in production.

Building Research Capability – Research Excellence:

–Demonstrates advanced knowledge in at least one business-critical applied research technology area.

–Applies advanced domain knowledge and industry best practices to applied research.

Building Research Capability – Research Community Presence:

–Leads the publication and presentation of research findings and papers in conferences, research and industry outlets, etc.

–Participates in the scientific community by providing peer review and feedback.

–Establishes collaboration with internal research labs.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative.

–Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives.

–Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs.

–Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices.

–Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions.

–Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

Continuous Learning:

–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices.

–Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills.

–Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

Continuous Improvement:

Performance and Development:

MCAPS-Core accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. Within MCAPS - Core, the Customer Service & Support (CSS) organization builds trust and confidence for every person and organization through delivering a seamless support experience. In CSS, we are powered by Microsoft’s AI technology to help consumers, businesses, partners, and more, resolve their issues quickly and securely, helping prevent future problems from occurring and achieving more from their Microsoft investment.

Microsoft’s SCIM organization is seeking a Principal Software AI Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and production deployment of agentic AI solutions that transform support experiences. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who can solve ambiguous, high-impact problems; set engineering direction; and translate support experience intent and readiness requirements into secure, reliable, and scalable AI systems.

You will combine deep software engineering expertise with applied AI judgment to build diagnostics, workflows, evaluation frameworks, and tooling that improve how support teams and customers resolve complex issues. You will work across engineering, product, program management, data, security, Responsible AI, and frontline support teams, influencing technical strategy while remaining close to implementation.

This role is suited to a principal-level engineer who combines strategic influence with deep hands-on execution. The ideal candidate is energized by ambiguous problems, makes sound architectural tradeoffs, learns rapidly as AI technologies evolve, and maintains a high bar for customer impact and operational excellence.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Architect and build production-grade AI systems. Design, implement, and operate agentic AI solutions, diagnostic experiences, orchestration workflows, and supporting platforms using governed ProCode and citizen-development technologies where appropriate.
Set technical direction. Define architecture, engineering strategy, design principles, and reusable patterns for AI solutions that must operate securely and reliably at enterprise scale.
Lead through code and engineering rigor. Develop critical components, conduct design and code reviews, establish testing standards, and resolve the most complex technical and architectural issues.
Integrate with the support ecosystem. Connect AI solutions to Microsoft support systems, APIs, knowledge sources, telemetry, and enterprise data while ensuring appropriate access controls and data handling.
Advance agent orchestration and diagnostics. Solve difficult problems in planning, context and state management, tool use, multi-agent coordination, retrieval, grounding, observability, and failure recovery.
Build robust evaluation capabilities. Establish technical, unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for prompts, models, tools, orchestration flows, and system integrations.
Validate quality and readiness. Evaluate groundedness, accuracy, task completion, robustness, latency, cost, safety, and failure modes at each deployment milestone in partnership with TPMs and support-domain experts.
Deliver enterprise-ready solutions. Deploy and operate services in Microsoft cloud environments in accordance with security, privacy, compliance, Responsible AI, reliability, and scalability requirements.
Define measurable outcomes. Establish success metrics and telemetry that demonstrate customer value, support effectiveness, engineering health, operational readiness, and suitability for scale.
Drive operational excellence. Create monitoring, incident response, debugging, and continuous-improvement mechanisms for AI systems in production.
Influence across organizations. Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to align priorities, manage technical tradeoffs, and deliver strategic initiatives spanning multiple organizations.
Grow engineering capability. Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar, promote thoughtful experimentation, and build a culture of inclusive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and high-quality execution.
Document for long-term success. Maintain clear architecture, design decisions, limitations, evaluation evidence, deployment guidance, and operational runbooks.

Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR equivalent experience

Other Qualifications

Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role’s job duties.
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and / or government security screening requirements are required for this role. At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for enterprises as a diverse team of creators and inventors. We combine the speed and mindset of a start-up with the scale, security, and customer focus of a leading enterprise software company.

OCI is seeking an exceptional Senior Principal Applied Scientist to develop AI-enabled platform capabilities for scientific and data-intensive enterprise use cases. This role will begin by addressing the needs of a large strategic customer and will evolve those learnings into scalable, reusable OCI platform capabilities for a broader customer base.

You will work at the intersection of applied natural sciences, data science, and AI engineering. You will partner closely with product management, customers, applied scientists, and software engineers to define problems, develop and evaluate solutions, and bring high-quality capabilities into production. This is an ideal role for a scientist who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, iterating quickly as customer needs evolve, and translating scientific domain knowledge into practical cloud and AI products.

As a Senior Principal Applied Scientist, you will provide technical leadership for complex, high-impact initiatives. You will establish scientific and technical direction, lead research and applied-development efforts, influence architecture and product strategy, and mentor other scientists and engineers.

Responsibilities

What You Will Bring

You are an applied scientist with strong scientific judgment, practical technical depth, and a customer-oriented mindset. You can move comfortably between scientific inquiry and product delivery: understanding a customer’s immediate problem, designing rigorous experiments, working with engineers to build a solution, and shaping that solution into a platform capability that can serve many customers. jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, AFT Quality
jobs.description:
Description

A fulfillment center can appear to be a chaotic place. With millions of items moving in and out of an area twice as large as your average theme park every day, a quick peek under the roof would reveal a manic scene. You would see associates, machinery, vehicles, robots, and packages flying about at break-neck speeds and accessing a breathtaking number of shelves and bins that store products. In reality, however, this activity is all highly organized and orchestrated by software, with each movement carefully planned and optimized. There are times when mistakes occur though, and products disappear, reappear in strange places, are damaged, or worse. When that happens, how does a fulfillment center operating at that size, speed, and scale recover gracefully and with minimal cost? How do we ensure that we meet our commitments to our customers and merchants? How do we find a needle in a haystack when we’re constantly shuffling the haystack around? And how do we do it at extreme scale in an environment of constant growth?

That’s where we come in, the AFT Quality team. Our goal is to prevent entropy in a system in which there are billions of transactions driven by human and robotic input across hundreds of millions of items every year. We must ensure that the virtual and physical state of the world is aligned inside hundreds of Amazon’s fulfillment centers globally. When our job is done well, mistakes are corrected quickly, and products are always ready to sell and ship.

We operate at a nexus of machine learning, computer vision, robotics, and healthy measure of hard-earned expertise in operations to build automated, algorithmic approaches to solving these problems at minimal cost. We create cutting edge software, building automated processes and workflows in the most complex operational problem space in the business world.

Key job responsibilities

Define the strategy and roadmap for solving the complex, ambiguous problems that emerge throughout fulfillment operations, driving org-wide alignment on the path forward.
Partner with customers and stakeholders to shape the requirements and specifications that define new product offerings from the ground up.
Collaborate with scientists to apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence technologies, including computer vision, to overcome challenges unique to the scale of the "everything store."
Own the end-to-end delivery of large-scale programs that advance the organization's long-term goals of improving customer satisfaction and lowering costs.
Lead high-stakes initiatives that cut across organizational boundaries, uniting disparate teams around a single outcome.
Communicate initiative status and strategy to senior leadership and stakeholders, keeping them aligned and bought in.

jobs.title: Chercheur(euse) principal(e) - Apprentissage automatique / Senior Researcher - Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Overview

(English will follow)

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) chercheur(euse) principal(e)
pour se joindre à notre équipe et contribuer à l’avancement de projets clés portant sur le développement d’agents de programmation fondés sur l’IA.

En tant que chercheur(euse) principal(e)
, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le développement, l’amélioration et l’exploration des capacités de modèles d’IA efficaces axés sur la programmation et la découverte. Votre travail aura une incidence importante sur le développement de technologies de pointe, en faisant progresser l’état de l’art et en offrant des solutions concrètes à des problèmes réels.

Notre Programme De Recherche Vise à Concevoir Des Agents De Programmation Plus Performants Et Plus Efficaces Grâce Aux Axes Suivants

Raisonnement et vérification – Permettre aux agents de décomposer des tâches de programmation complexes en étapes gérables, de planifier efficacement, de rechercher des solutions adéquates, ainsi que de formuler et de vérifier leurs hypothèses.
Interaction et mémoire – Entraîner des agents capables d’évoluer dans des environnements de développement, d’exécuter du code, d’interpréter les commentaires provenant d’outils et de tests, d’améliorer leurs résultats de manière itérative et de conserver une mémoire des événements passés.
Environnements synthétiques et génération de données – Créer, à la demande, des environnements dans lesquels les agents peuvent mettre en pratique et développer leurs compétences.

Microsoft Research Montréal offre un environnement favorable à la recherche de pointe, une politique de publication ouverte ainsi que des liens étroits avec des établissements universitaires de premier plan au sein de la communauté montréalaise de l’intelligence artificielle, notamment Mila, ainsi qu’avec des établissements partout dans le monde.

#MSRR #Research

Chez Microsoft, notre mission, qui consiste à donner à chaque personne et à chaque organisation les moyens d’en faire davantage, guide la façon dont nous collaborons avec nos clients afin de leur offrir des solutions fiables et porteuses d’impact. Grâce à une culture axée sur l’apprentissage et la croissance, nous innovons de façon responsable et mesurons notre réussite par les progrès que nous réalisons ensemble, pour les personnes, les équipes et les clients. Joignez-vous à nous pour accomplir un travail porteur de sens qui contribue à changer le monde et à façonner l’avenir pour tous.

We are seeking a Senior Researcher
 to join our team and contribute to the advancement of key projects around agentic coding.

As a Senior Researcher
, you will play a crucial role in developing, improving, and exploring the capabilities of efficient, discovery-oriented AI coding models. Your work will have a significant impact on the development of cutting-edge technologies, advancing state-of-the-art and providing practical solutions to real-world problems.

Our research agenda centers on building more capable and efficient coding agents via:

Reasoning & Verification — Enabling agents to decompose complex programming tasks into manageable steps, plan effectively, search for correct solutions, verbalize and verify their hypotheses.
Interaction & Memory — Training agents that can operate within development environments, execute code, interpret feedback from tools and tests, and iteratively refine their outputs and maintain a memory of what happened.
Synthetic Environment and Data Generation – Creating environments on demand where agents can practice their skills.

Microsoft Research Montreal offers a supportive environment for cutting-edge research, an open publications policy, and close ties to top academic institutions in the Montreal AI community, such as Mila, and around the world.

#MSRR #Research

At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.

Responsibilities

En tant que chercheur(euse) principal(e), vous concevrez, développerez, exécuterez et mettrez en œuvre des projets de recherche technologique en collaboration avec d’autres chercheurs, ingénieurs et groupes de produits.
À titre de membre d’une organisation de recherche de calibre mondial, vous contribuerez à des avancées majeures dans le domaine et aurez l’occasion de concrétiser vos idées dans des produits et services utilisés partout dans le monde.
As a Senior Researcher, you will design, develop, execute, and implement technology research projects in collaboration with other researchers, engineers, and product groups. 
As a member of a world-class research organization, you will be a part of research breakthroughs in the field and will be given an opportunity to realize your ideas in products and services used worldwide.

Qualifications

Qualifications requises/minimales

Doctorat dans un domaine pertinent OU maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent ET au moins 3 ans d’expérience connexe en recherche
OU baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ET au moins 4 ans d’expérience connexe en recherche.
OU expérience équivalente.

Autres Exigences

Comment postuler :

Afin de nous assurer de recevoir une candidature complète, veuillez suivre les instructions suivantes:

Téléversez votre curriculum vitæ (CV)
Téléversez, sous forme de pièces jointes distinctes à votre candidature, un ou deux articles de conférence ou de revue, chapitres de livre, liens vers des billets de blogue, rapports techniques ou échantillons de travaux écrits équivalents (potentiellement non publiés) dont vous êtes le plus fier ou la plus fière.
Téléversez une courte lettre de présentation (maximum de deux pages) décrivant les réalisations techniques dont vous êtes le plus fier ou la plus fière jusqu’à présent, ainsi que ce que vous souhaitez continuer à accomplir à l’avenir. N’hésitez pas à mentionner également d’autres activités de recherche auxquelles vous avez participé, notamment le bénévolat, l’engagement civique ou l’organisation communautaire.
Ajoutez les coordonnées de deux ou trois personnes qui rédigeront des lettres de recommandation (dans presque tous les cas, l’une d’entre elles sera votre directeur ou directrice de thèse). Après avoir soumis votre candidature, le système enverra, en votre nom, une demande de lettre aux personnes que vous avez indiquées comme références. Remarque : le système de candidature ne demandera les lettres de recommandation qu’après la soumission de votre candidature.

Après avoir soumis votre candidature, le système enverra, en votre nom, une demande de lettre aux personnes que vous avez indiquées comme références. Remarque : le système de candidature ne demandera les lettres de recommandation qu’après la soumission de votre candidature.

Qualifications Souhaitées

Programme de recherche démontré par des publications présentées aux conférences suivantes : NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, COLM, ACL, NAACL, CVPR, COLT, ECCV, ICCV et EMNLP.
Expérience dans la réalisation d’expériences à grande échelle portant sur le préentraînement et/ou l’ajustement fin de transformeurs ou de grands modèles de langage (LLM).
Expérience en apprentissage par renforcement agentique, notamment en clonage comportemental à grande échelle et en optimisation de politiques.
Expérience dans la création, l’optimisation et l’exécution de pipelines d’apprentissage automatique à grande échelle.
Expérience dans la création de pipelines de collecte et de curation de données. Capacité à collaborer, à communiquer efficacement et à travailler au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire.
Intérêt marqué pour les applications concrètes et leur incidence.
Expérience favorisant la diversité, l’inclusion et le sentiment d’appartenance dans un environnement de recherche.
Les lettres de recommandation sont les bienvenues, mais ne sont pas obligatoires. Veuillez les joindre si elles sont disponibles.

Required Qualifications

Doctorate in relevant field OR Master's Degree in relevant field AND 3+ years related research experience
OR Bachelor's Degree in relevant field AND 4+ years related research experience.
OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

How to Apply:

To ensure we receive a complete application from you, please be sure to follow these instructions:

Upload your Resume/CV. 
Upload (as separate attachments to your application) 1 or 2 conference or journal articles, book chapters, link to blog posts, technical reports or equivalent (potentially unpublished) writing samples that you are most proud of.
Upload a short cover letter (no more than 2 pages) outlining technical achievements so far that you are most proud of and what you aim to continue doing moving forward. Feel free to also add extra research activities such as volunteering, civic engagement, community organizing that you might have been part of.
Add contact information for 2/3 reference letter writers (in nearly all cases, one will be from your dissertation advisor).

After you submit your application, the system will send a request for letters to your list of references on your behalf. Note: The application system will not request reference letters until after you have submitted your application

Preferred Qualifications

Research program demonstrated by publications at the following conferences: NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, COLM, ACL, NAACL, CVPR, COLT, ECCV, ICCV, EMNLP
Experience in running large scale experiments with transformers/LLMs pre-training and/or finetuning
Experience with agentic reinforcement learning, including large scale behavior cloning and policy optimization
Experience in creating, optimizing and running large scale machine learning pipelines
Experience in building data collection and curation pipelines. Ability to collaborate, communicate effectively, and work as part of a multi-disciplinary team.
Keen interest in real-world applications and impact.
Experience fostering diversity, inclusion and belonging in a research environment
Reference letters are welcomed, though they are not mandatory. Please include them if available.

Our TPMs have a significant business impact crafting and building new systems to power our customers business critical applications. You will work on delivery of various OCI services, including cloud migration service and leading enterprise hybrid cloud service.

In this Senior Principal Technical Program Management role, you will be working across a multi-functional team that understands our business and its objectives, to lead us through planning and designing technical solutions to solve the business’s problems in a very agile, fast-paced, and collaborative environment. The position relies heavily on influence rather than authority to drive projects.

You will define project scopes, plan and direct schedules while focusing on regular and timely delivery of value; organize and lead project status and working meetings; prepare and distribute progress reports; manage risks and issues; correct deviations from plans; and perform delivery planning for assigned projects.

Senior Growth Product Manager – Adobe Experience Cloud

The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Cloud enables enterprises to deliver personalized, data-driven digital experiences at scale. We are seeking a Senior Growth Product Manager
to drive Product-Led Growth (PLG)
across Experience Cloud products by accelerating user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion.

This role is ideal for a growth leader with deep experience in B2B SaaS and Digital Marketing Technology
, who thrives at the intersection of product, experimentation and data. You will drive and implement growth strategies across key user journeys, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Go-To-Market teams to turn customer insight into scalable growth engines.

What You’ll Do

Growth Strategy & Lifecycle Management

Drive and evolve end-to-end growth strategies across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion for an Experience Cloud product.
Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using data, research and experimentation.
Develop and prioritize a growth roadmap tied to clear business impact.

Experimentation & Optimization

Design, launch, and analyze a high-velocity experimentation program across critical user journeys.
Drive rapid test-and-learn cycles that ensure rigorous experiment design by establishing clear hypotheses, calculating statistical power, and implementing appropriate guardrails.
Collaborate with engineering and data teams to build robust instrumentation for accurate measurement and monitoring. Oversee careful rollout strategies—including phased launches, A/B testing, and control groups—to minimize risk and improve actionable insights.

Technology-Based Growth Initiatives

Identify, prioritize, and ship product experiences powered by advanced technology that improve conversion and retention—e.g., personalization, predictive mentorship, and intelligent onboarding.
Use AI to speed up experiment ideation, hypothesis generation, copy/variant drafting, and analysis—while maintaining statistical rigor and human review.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with cross-functional leaders to co-develop and implement growth initiatives, navigating trade-offs and driving alignment across teams
Proven ability to influence product roadmaps and drive outcomes in a matrixed environment without direct authority
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning multiple teams around shared goals

Job Description

OCI Strategic Customer Engineering is seeking an experienced Principal Program Manager with technical interests to lead large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that drive strategic outcomes across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure which span highly technical and business-centric delivery. This role is ideal for an accomplished program leader who thrives in highly technical environments, excels at navigating ambiguity, and has a proven ability to deliver complex programs from inception through execution.

You are a results-oriented leader who drives execution—not just coordination. You possess strong judgment, exceptional ownership, and a bias for action. You dig deep to master a space and understand it full. You build trusted partnerships across engineering, product management, operations, customer success, and executive leadership to align teams around common objectives and deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.

As a Principal Program Manager, you will lead programs that span multiple OCI organizations, helping teams prioritize, execute, and deliver initiatives that improve operational excellence, customer success, and strategic business objectives. The work is highly visible, fast-paced, and requires balancing technical complexity with operational and business complexity with organizational alignment.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of experience in Program Management, Software Engineering, Product Management, or related technical leadership roles
Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional programs across multiple engineering organizations

Demonstrated ability to drive execution in complex, fast-moving environments with multiple stakeholders
Experience developing program plans, tracking execution, managing dependencies, and mitigating risks
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision making
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership
Proven ability to influence without direct authority and build consensus across diverse organizations
Strong customer focus with the ability to balance technical priorities and business objectives
Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of experience in Program Management or engineering leadership
Experience working with cloud-native architectures and large-scale distributed systems
Experience managing strategic customer programs or enterprise cloud initiatives
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and modern software development methodologies
Experience working directly with executive stakeholders and large enterprise customers

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

Program Leadership

Lead complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and successful delivery.
Define program goals, milestones, success metrics, and execution plans that align with organizational priorities.
Coordinate engineering, product management, operations, and customer success teams to deliver high-impact initiatives.
Drive program governance, status reporting, executive communications, and stakeholder alignment.
Identify program risks, dependencies, and execution challenges while developing proactive mitigation strategies.
Establish scalable program management processes and mechanisms that improve organizational execution.
Manage competing priorities and ensure successful delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Break down complex technical initiatives into manageable workstreams with clear ownership and accountability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Build strong partnerships across OCI engineering, product, operations, support, and executive leadership teams.
Drive alignment across organizations to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.
Facilitate technical and business discussions that enable informed decision-making and accelerate delivery.
Communicate program status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Foster collaboration across geographically distributed teams and organizations.

Operational Excellence

Identify opportunities to improve processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and increase organizational efficiency.
Develop repeatable mechanisms, dashboards, and reporting processes that improve program visibility and execution.
Lead post-launch reviews and continuous improvement efforts to enhance program delivery.
Support strategic planning activities, roadmap execution, and organizational prioritization.
Help teams scale effectively by implementing best practices for program management and operational excellence.

Customer & Business Impact

Partner with internal and external stakeholders to understand customer priorities and translate them into executable programs.
Drive initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
Balance customer needs, technical constraints, and organizational priorities while making informed tradeoff decisions.

Strategic initiatives are delivered on time, with high quality and strong cross-functional alignment.
Engineering, product, and business teams have clear visibility into priorities, risks, and execution progress.
Operational processes scale efficiently as the organization grows.
Executive stakeholders have confidence in program execution through consistent communication and measurable outcomes.
OCI Strategic Customer Engineering successfully delivers initiatives that improve customer experience, operational excellence, and business performance.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

The digital advertising landscape is undergoing an unprecedented privacy-driven change. As user expectations, regulatory requirements, and industry standards evolve rapidly, the Ads Identity & Infrastructure team is at the forefront of this transformation. Our mission is to build cutting-edge solutions that preserve user data privacy while continuing to support Google's Ad business across Search, Video, Display, and Apps.

In this role, you will own the direction and roadmap for critical Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PETs). You will navigate complex technical, business, and regulatory tradeoffs to define a product strategy that balances privacy protections with monetization goals. Partnering closely with engineering, policy, and legal teams—as well as engaging directly with Ads Executive leadership—your work will directly shape the future of privacy across the entire digital advertising ecosystem.

new_jobs.title: Director, Global Order-to-Cash Transformation
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

We're looking for an operational leader to partner with engineering, finance and accounting operational leaders to transform Anthropic's global order-to-cash (O2C) function. Our business is scaling faster than the processes and systems that support it, across direct enterprise contracts, consumption-based commercial models, and third-party cloud marketplaces. This role is a key partner with the end-to-end redesign: how orders are structured and provisioned, how transactions flow through our systems, how revenue is billed and recognized, and how all of it stays controlled and auditable as volume compounds.

This is a builder's role with a broad remit. You'll help set the multi-year Global O2C roadmap and then manage the critical aspects such as designing front-to-back processes, standing up automation and AI-driven tooling where manual work doesn't scale. Facilitating programs that cut across Finance, Go-to-Market, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and Engineering.

If you're energized by ambiguous, high-consequence operational problems at a company at the forefront of AI development, we'd like to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Global O2C Strategy & Transformation

Be a key contributor to the vision, roadmap, and execution of Anthropic's global order-to-cash transformation, spanning order management, provisioning, billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition
Assess the current state end-to-end, identify the structural constraints on scale, and sequence a prioritized program of work with clear milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes
Build the operating metrics and reporting that make O2C performance legible to leadership — cycle times, error and rework rates, touchless transaction rates, revenue leakage, and cost to serve
Serve as the senior operational voice in commercial and pricing workflows, translating what the business wants to sell into what we can actually transact, bill, and recognize

Process Design & Operational Excellence

Design scalable, controlled processes from the ground up, applying structured process design and continuous improvement methodology rather than incremental patching
Standardize and harmonize O2C processes globally across regions, entities, channels, and business models, eliminating the one-off exception handling that accumulates in high-growth environments
Establish clear operating rhythms, escalation paths, and service levels across the quote-to-cash lifecycle, with documentation that holds up as the team and transaction volume grow
Build the operational infrastructure that lets the function absorb order-of-magnitude growth without a proportional increase in headcount
Build compliance monitoring into the systems, including SOX controls, themselves so that controls scale with volume rather than headcount

Systems, Automation & AI

Help drive the O2C systems architecture and roadmap in partnership with O2C Leadership, Engineering and GTM Systems, defining requirements, prioritizing investment, and holding the line on scalable solutions over point fixes
Deploy AI and automation to drive real leverage across the function — automated exception handling and reconciliation, self-service reporting and anomaly detection, and continuous rather than sample-based control monitoring
Lead global automation strategy and evaluation across billing, contracting, and ERP platforms, and drive the implementations and migrations that follow

Cross-Functional Leadership

Drive alignment and results across Revenue Accounting, Deal Desk, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Engineering, influencing outcomes without relying on direct authority
Partner with high-performing operations teams, setting standards, developing talent, and scaling capacity through a mix of employees, contractors, and partners
Communicate progress, trade-offs, risks, and decisions crisply to executive stakeholders, and surface issues early with a recommended path forward

You may be a good fit if you have

10+ years of progressive experience leading operational transformations within Revenue Operations, Billing Operations, or other finance operational teams at high-growth SaaS/technology companies, including experience leading cross-functionally
Expert understanding of process design, cross-functional project management, and scaling systems — including using AI to drive automation, reporting, and compliance
Project management certification (PMP) or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
Expert understanding of quote-to-cash processes for SaaS, covering both subscription and consumption-based business models across B2B products
Extensive experience with contracting systems, billing platforms, and ERP systems (e.g., Salesforce, Stripe, NetSuite, Oracle, Workday Financials, Zuora)
A proven track record leading large-scale strategic and automation initiatives end-to-end, from business case through implementation and adoption
Experience building and developing operations teams
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, or a related field

Strong candidates may also have

Experience serving both B2C and B2B customers; especially with consumption-based, subscription billing models through to collections
Experience with go-to-market, deal desk and revenue operations organizations
Experience designing and implementing processes with robust internal controls, segregation of duties frameworks and flow of financial transactions in high-growth environments
Understanding of AI industry business models and enterprise customer needs

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$230,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. As Head of Regulated Industries – Customer Success at Anthropic, you'll lead the Success teams responsible for our most complex Financial Services (FSI) and Healthcare & Life Sciences (HCLS) customers. Think banks, insurers, asset and wealth managers and financial data providers; health systems, hospitals and payers; and pharmaceutical, biotech and life-sciences organizations. You'll directly coach and develop a team of Customer Success Managers who drive value across the full product portfolio (Claude Platform, Claude Code, Claude Cowork). These are organizations where deployment runs through compliance, procurement, security review, model risk and legal before it reaches an end user.

You'll partner day to day with the Regulated Industries sales organization so that customers experience one Anthropic from first conversation to production. Executive programs that reach the CIO, CISO, CRO and compliance leaders who decide whether Claude gets deployed. Expansion plays that survive long procurement cycles.

You’ll inherit a partially formed team, spanning individual contributors and managers. You'll hire and run the initial team yourself. As the book expands you'll continue to add managers underneath you and manage through them. We're looking for someone who has already led a success business in regulated environments and wants to build the operating model that lets it scale.

Description

Product Management leader for Stores features (safety messages, recalls, and more) and high-visibility regulatory products to lead an ambitious expansion.

Compliance & Safety Services (CoSS) builds best-in-class compliance and safety solutions that serve Amazon Buyers, Selling Partners (SPs), regulatory authorities, third-party compliance providers, and Amazon's internal teams. We streamline compliance processes to reduce burden on SPs while boosting Amazon's operational efficiency and enhancing customer experience. We achieve this by focusing on these four themes: 1) Ensure "no store, no policy and no business model is left behind"; 2) Transform the Selling Partner Lifecycle — Simplify Compliance, Elevate Seller Experience; 3) Reduce the Total Cost of Ownership; and 4) Shape the future of compliance through external collaboration and influence.

The External Products team in CoSS owns buyer, regulator, and stakeholder communications products for sharing safety and compliance information, as well as emerging products to extend RISC's investment in these capabilities with sellers and other enterprise customers. We are seeking a Senior Manager, Product Management - Technical (PMT) to lead product management for CoSS External Products. This leader will own the product vision and roadmap across the team's portfolio, which includes Buyer Safety Experience (BSX), Regulator Management, and our expanding focus on externalizing RISC's compliance and safety technology for use beyond Amazon's marketplace.

This role reports to the CoSS External Products leader and requires a product management leader who has repeatedly brought software products to market — someone who can define product strategy in ambiguous spaces, work backwards from diverse customer sets (consumers, regulators, and businesses), and drive execution across cross-functional teams.

Own the 3–5 year product vision and roadmap for CoSS External Products

Recruit, hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of product managers; set clear expectations and growth paths for each team member

Foster a team culture of ownership, curiosity, and customer obsession; create an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives drive better products

Drive strategic communications internally and externally; present to senior leadership on product strategy, investment cases, and results

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management (External Services), AWS Identity & Secrets
new_jobs.description:
Description

Every application has to answer two questions before it can do anything: who are you, and what's the secret that proves it? You'll shape how AWS customers answer both — at a scale measured in hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

We're looking for a Senior Product Management leader to set the direction for two of AWS's most foundational security services — Amazon Cognito (customer identity and authentication) and AWS Secrets Manager (managing the secrets and credentials applications rely on) — and to build the team behind them. Each service has its own customers, its own roadmap, and its own reason to exist. Your job is to lead the product team across both, sharpen the strategy for each, and find the places where the two add up to more than the sum of their parts. You'll own the whole story — vision, roadmap, go-to-market, and pricing — and you'll ground your calls in data, not opinions. It's a high-visibility role: the roadmap you own gets reviewed by AWS's most senior leaders, and you'll be working at the center of how identity and secrets are evolving for the next generation of applications and AWS workload identity.

Key job responsibilities

Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Cognito and Secrets Manager — growing each as a first-class product, and spotting the bets that connect them.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers — set the bar for the craft, help people build their careers, and raise the ceiling on what the team can take on.
Own go-to-market and pricing — partner with sales, marketing, and field teams on how you launch and drive adoption, and make the pricing calls that shape how customers buy and grow.
Run the business by the numbers — decide which metrics matter, partner with your analytics and business intelligence team to build the reporting behind them, and let the data drive where you invest.
Turn customer signal into the bets worth funding — figure out where the next wave of growth comes from, and make the case that gets it resourced.
Translate what customers need into what engineering builds — write the narratives, requirements, and user stories that give the team an unambiguous target, and stay with it from idea to launch.
Make the hard prioritization calls across a wide set of partners — engineering, security, field, and partner teams — clearing roadblocks and building the buy-in to move.
Bring senior leaders along — earn agreement on the vision and the plan at the most senior levels, and never let leadership get surprised on risk.
Stay close to the craft — this is a hands-on product leader, not a manager who's stepped away from the work. Expect to spend part of your time building product yourself.

A day in the life

You start the morning on a customer escalation about rotating secrets at scale, and turn it into a roadmap question your team digs into together. By the afternoon you're in an adoption dashboard with your analytics partner, deciding whether a recent pricing change is actually working — then pressure-testing the story with engineering before a leadership review. You're just as comfortable in the doc, in the data, and in the room.

About The Team

We build the services that let applications answer two basic questions: who is this, and can I trust the secret that proves it? Amazon Cognito signs users in for developers worldwide, and AWS Secrets Manager protects the credentials their applications depend on — both at enormous scale.

We're a self-contained product team: product managers, engineers, a customer-facing solutions architect, and analytics partners, so an idea can travel from a customer's problem to a shipped feature without leaving the group. We start from customer signal, argue from data, and stay hands-on. Our ambition: make identity and secrets the secure, obvious default for every builder on AWS.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
Experience in people management
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of successful technology products work from ideation through launch experience
Experience delivering technology products or services in a high growth environment
Experience shaping business strategy for technical products or services for large enterprises or partners
Experience with cloud native technologies
Experience leading product development start to finish, including shipping customer-facing products, with the ability to drive prioritization consensus across business units and serve as an effective liaison between customers and engineering

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management Technical, External Services, Amazon Connect Customer
new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch Amazon Connect has become an AI leader transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Amazon Connect Customer is an agentic customer experience offering that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. With Amazon Connect Customer businesses deploy intelligent self-service across voice and digital channels that understands natural language, draws from knowledge sources, and takes action on behalf of customers. Amazon Connect Customer leverages agentic AI across AWS and Amazon services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, and Amazon Transcribe to deliver sub-second voice latency human-like conversational quality and self-healing intelligence that detects where AI fails and continuously improves. With this technology we are transforming the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them. A key part of this role is leading conversational AI and end-customer self-service across Amazon Connect Customer. You will own the voice AI agent strategy speech technologies and the full self-service experience that defines how end-customers interact with businesses. Are you passionate about helping organizations manage governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) at cloud scale? AWS is building a new AI-powered GRC service that delivers continuous compliance, real-time risk quantification, and governance for AI agent workloads. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to own and drive critical product areas as we scale this service for enterprise adoption.

About The Opportunity

The GRC market is $60B+ and undergoing a fundamental transformation. Point-in-time audits are becoming untenable as enterprises operate across multi-cloud and hybrid environments that change daily. AI agents are proliferating faster than compliance programs can adapt. No incumbent GRC vendor has a credible solution for continuous, AI-native governance. AWS is uniquely positioned to win here — and we're building the team to make it happen.

In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, requirements, and go-to-market for a core set of capabilities within a new cloud-native GRC service. You will work backwards from enterprise GRC buyers — compliance officers, risk managers, CISOs, and audit teams — to define what we build and why. You will partner with engineering, science, UX, marketing, sales, and legal to deliver capabilities that win in a competitive and rapidly evolving market.

This is a high-ownership role. You will define the product vision for your area, author PRFAQs and requirements documents, make pricing and packaging decisions, and drive adoption post-launch. You will operate at the intersection of deep domain expertise in compliance/audit/risk and strong technical product management fundamentals.

Leverage deep audit and compliance expertise — direct experience conducting, managing, or overseeing audits — to define product requirements that solve real practitioner pain points

Own the product strategy and roadmap for a core domain within a new AI-powered GRC service — from vision through delivery and adoption

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Microsoft 365 carries a large share of the world's business communication, and almost none of it reaches a mailbox without passing through Substrate Transport. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a core area of that pipeline: to set its direction, define what we build, and carry the work through to an outcome that customers and the business can measure.

This role suits someone comfortable with depth. The problems are technical, the systems are hyper scale and long-lived, and the right answer usually depends on evidence you go and find yourself. In return you get genuine ownership of a service every Microsoft 365 customer depends on, and a team that expects you to lead rather than coordinate.

Substrate Transport is the engine that routes, filters, and delivers the messages that flow through Microsoft 365. Our mission is to move mail reliably, safely, and efficiently at planetary scale, and to give the workloads built on the platform they can depend on without having to reason about the plumbing underneath.

The team's scope follows the full path a message takes: submission and ingestion, routing and categorization, policy and compliance enforcement, hygiene and anti-abuse controls, and final delivery to a mailbox or an external destination. It also covers the connector and hybrid surfaces that customers configure themselves, the volumetric and throttling controls that keep the service healthy under load, and the continued modernization of infrastructure that predates the cloud era.

This position is based at the Redmond campus with 3 days per week work in the office and 2 days per week work from home. Domestic relocation assistance is available.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

You will own a focus area within the transport pipeline from definition through shipped outcome, working alongside engineering leads, partner PM teams across Exchange Online and Microsoft 365, and the service engineers who keep mail flowing every day.

Define the product

Set the strategy and roadmap for your area of the pipeline, grounded in customer promises rather than in a feature list. Write the specs that engineering builds from, state the hypothesis each investment is testing, and say plainly how you will know whether it worked.

Align the business and technical strategy for the area, including how it fits the broader Substrate and Microsoft 365 direction, and make the trade-offs between short-term relief and the long-term architecture the service needs.

Drive execution

Run your area through the full engineering lifecycle: scope, safe rollout, telemetry, and the operational readiness a service of this size demands. Anticipate the dependency that will slip before it slips, and hold a mitigation ready when it does.

Carry security, privacy, compliance, and accessibility obligations as part of the definition of done rather than as a late review gate, and make sure changes to mail flow are validated before they reach customers at scale.

Own the outcome

Own one or more service or business metrics for your area and build the roadmap that moves them. Go directly to the telemetry, message traces, and large-scale data the service produces, and use both the quantitative and the qualitative signal to frame the problem before proposing a solution.

Represent the area to leadership, to partner teams, and to customers, simplifying a complex system enough for a decision to be made without flattening the detail that matters.

Lead the team around you

Raise the bar for how the team works: sharpen other people's specs with real feedback, mentor less experienced product managers, and establish patterns your teammates choose to copy because they make the work go faster.

Resolve problems that need cross-organizational alignment, securing commitment from teams that do not report to you and that may not share your goals.

Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical (PMT) to own the Quality of Service (QoS) and Performance domain within Leo Networking. In this role, you will define the products and features that ensure Leo delivers on its performance promises — from core performance assurance to traffic shaping and congestion management algorithms. You will work at the intersection of networking engineering, satellite systems, and customer experience to build differentiated, measurable, and enforceable Performance & QoS capabilities.

This is a high-visibility role that requires deep technical acumen in networking, strong product sense, and the ability to influence across engineering, business, and leadership. You will own the Performance and QoS roadmap from concept through launch, write PRFAQs and technical requirements, and represent the customer’s performance expectations in every architectural decision.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end Performance and QoS product strategy for Leo, including traffic classification, prioritization, shaping, and congestion management.

Define and drive the performance metrics framework — establishing SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs that govern throughput, latency, jitter, and packet loss across the Leo network.

Partner with Principal Engineers and SDEs to prioritize and implement network performance capabilities and enforcement mechanisms across the satellite, ground gateway, and SDN layers.

Write PRFAQs, technical narratives, and requirement documents to secure resources and align leadership on the network performance roadmap.

Collaborate with sales, demand management, and capacity management to gather customer performance requirements and translate them into product features.

Define acceptance criteria and performance gates for new feature performance capabilities, ensuring QoS compliance before customer-facing releases.

Work cross-functionally with the Beam Planning, SDN, and Satellite Operations teams to optimize resource allocation and minimize latency, packet loss, and congestion across the constellation.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with a review of overnight performance dashboards — checking throughput, latency percentiles, and congestion events across active beams and ground gateways. You notice a pattern in peak-hour congestion for a specific geographic region and draft a quick analysis to bring to your engineering sync.

Mid-morning, you’re in a design review with the SDN team, debating the trade-offs of a new traffic shaping algorithm that could improve P99 latency for enterprise customers but may impact other traffic. You push for a data-driven approach, proposing an A/B test framework to validate the change in a controlled environment.

After lunch, you’re on a call with an enterprise customer’s network architect who wants to understand how Amazon Leo’s quality of service compares to their existing MPLS-based WAN, and how to best integrate Leo connectivity in parallel to their existing MPLS WAN behind an SDWAN appliance. You walk them through Leo’s service plan tiers, SLA commitments, and the telemetry they’ll have access to.

In the afternoon, you’re drafting the PRFAQ for the next phase of network performance— introducing dynamic bandwidth allocation that adapts to real-time demand patterns. You collaborate with a principal engineer to ensure the technical approach is sound, and align with sales, capacity, and finance teams on the financial impact. You end the day with a quick sync with the Beam Planning team to review capacity forecasts for the upcoming month.

About The Team

The Leo Connectivity Product team is responsible for the end-to-end networking stack that delivers connectivity from customer terminals through the satellite constellation to ground gateways and back to the terrestrial internet. We work across the control plane and data plane services that make Leo a carrier-grade networking provider.

Our team culture values deep technical curiosity, customer obsession, and a bias for action. We operate with a startup mentality inside Amazon — moving fast, iterating on data, and shipping capabilities that directly impact customer experience. We are builders who are energized by the challenge of delivering consistent, high-performance networking from a dynamic constellation of LEO satellites.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe the best products come from teams with varied perspectives and experiences.

Basic Qualifications

Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
Experience defining and managing SLAs/SLOs for networking or cloud services.
Strong understanding of network performance fundamentals: IP DSCP, L2 CoS, traffic classification, marking, shaping, network queuing disciplines, fair queueing, CoDel, WRED, bufferbloat
Track record of writing technical requirements documents, PRFAQs, or product specifications.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems
Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own
Experience with satellite communications, LEO networking, or space-based systems.
Experience in customer-facing technical product role at a cloud provider or telecommunications company.
Familiarity with AWS networking services (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPC) and how enterprise customers build hybrid networks.

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

Review, update, and approve equipment submittals
Work with global liquid cooling equipment suppliers and manufacturers
Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g. reliability, operations, design, compliance)

Develop Product Roadmaps
Listen to the voice of the customer to understand technical and business requirements
